{{Top|leg}}
'''Swendo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] official in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who was employed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Swendo was rumored to be in the Empire's pocket, and after [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] of his financial records revealed numerous payments from Imperial sources, he was arrested along with a number of other traitors identified by his records.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Shady Dealings}}</ref>
